settings.title: PalGate
settings.subtitle: Connect your PalGate account to open your gates from Homey.
settings.notConnectedHint: Link Homey as an extra device on your PalGate account. You don't need your password or an SMS code.
settings.step1: Tap Link with PalGate app below.
settings.step2: In the PalGate app, go to Device Linking, then Link a Device.
settings.step3: Scan the QR code. Homey connects by itself.
settings.qrAlt: QR code for linking with the PalGate app
settings.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect from PalGate? Your gates in Homey stop opening until you connect again.
settings.openFor: Show the gate as open for
settings.openForHint: PalGate doesn't report if the gate is really open. Homey shows it as open for this long after each open command, then as closed.
settings.manualHint: Only needed if you already have a PalGate session token, for example from another PalGate integration. Otherwise use Link with PalGate app above.

status.linked: Connected. You can now add your gates under Devices.
